NBA DFS Picks for Sunday, November 15 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 5 games · First game 6:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 15, 11:38 AM ET

Jalen Johnson (ATL) is the top-projected player on the Sunday, November 15 DraftKings main slate at 50.7 DraftKings points for $9,600. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 50.6, $10,600) and Jayson Tatum (BOS, 49.9, $10,100) are next.

Reed Sheppard (HOU) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.78 projected points per $1,000 at $4,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 15, 11:38 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
